name: ♻️ Deposit Simulator
desc:
An incremental recycling simulator where you return cans and bottles through a deposit return machine. Recycle your containers and earn your deposit back!

🥤 Collect cans and bottles!
💰 Return containers and claim your deposit!
🚀 Upgrade your equipment to recycle faster!
🌍 Unlock new locations and better sill trees!

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a Like and add it to your Favorites!
